title: Rawr
blurb: "Rawr" is a word that mostly exists in text, delivered here out loud with full commitment. It belongs to a very specific era of the internet: scene kids, dinosaur avatars, and the phrase "rawr means I love you in dinosaur" scrawled across a MySpace profile in a font nobody could read. It has since been reclaimed as ironic playfulness, which is roughly what happens to everything eventually. Good for playful threats, cursed nostalgia, and pretending to be a very small dinosaur.
origin: The spoken version of the scene-era internet 'rawr'.
